meaning: Individual option entries distinguish an AI preliminary not-the-best-answer screen from an independently verified scientific falsehood. Some wrong-option statements may be true in other contexts or merely unsupported by the described test.
limits: A QA-only first-pass is not an independent qualified teacher adjudication.
A distractor can be factually true in general yet be incorrect for the exact question; do not label every wrong choice as universally scientifically false.
Do not infer TGS teaching scope from the national syllabus.
